prompt: Original square seamless game terrain diffuse/albedo texture for Orlando MX in Florida, not a scene render. Orthographic top-down scan-like soil filling the image edge to edge. A four-metre-wide patch of Florida motocross sandy loam, warm earth brown with tan sand and muted clay undertone. Fine sand grains, crumbly 2-20 mm clods, low to moderate contrast, scattered small compacted clods. Dry-to-slightly moist matte finish. Flat diffuse cross-polarized light, no directional cast shadows or light gradients, no perspective. Fine stochastic detail without unique large landmarks; seamless edges. No tire marks, vegetation, large rocks, text, border or watermark. New original photographic asset, not a copy of another track texture.
calibration: Artist-guided visual color matching; not a calibrated soil scan
